description: This file contains unit tests for the AuthProviderDao class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CRUD operations and data retrieval related to OpenID authentication providers within the OpenidAuthentication plugin.

classes.name: AuthProviderDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the AuthProviderDao data access object functions related to OpenID providers within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data from fixtures before each test method runs.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an OpenID provider by its ID.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderDetailsByProviderId
methods.description: Tests retrieving detailed information for an OpenID provider by provider ID.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviders
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of OpenID providers with limits and offsets.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of available OpenID providers.

methods.name: testDeleteProviders
methods.description: Tests soft deleting providers by setting their status to inactive.

methods.name: testSaveProvider
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new OpenIdProvider.

methods.name: testSaveAuthProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Tests saving extra authentication details for a provider.

methods.name: testGetAuthProvidersForLoginPage
methods.description: Tests retrieving providers suitable for display on the login page.
